title: Mainsah et al. 2025 — bigP3BCI: An Open, Diverse and Machine Learning Ready P300-based Brain-Computer Interface Dataset (Study G)
description: Study G of the bigP3BCI collection, a large open P300-based brain-computer interface dataset. It contains 16-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz from 20 healthy participants using a 9x8 character speller grid with checkerboard/dynamic stimulus presentation. Target and non-target events are annotated with HED tags, and the data support machine learning work on P300 speller classification.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier from 16 channels placed in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz. Participants completed a calibration phase followed by online testing with feedback in a laboratory P300 speller task. Target and non-target flashes were labeled as events with a 0-1.0 s trial interval.
